verbatim_verdict_text:
## What I observed, in order

1. **Website loading surface:** The video opens with a blank white page, then D&D Beyond’s own dark navigation bar and branded loading screen with a rotating red progress indicator appear. This is **the website’s work**, not the extension’s.

2. **Website character sheet:** The character sheet for “Corvo Saggio” loads, showing D&D Beyond’s character information, ability scores, actions, defenses, and navigation tabs. The D&D Beyond navigation, artwork, text, and sheet structure are **the website’s work**.

3. **Early enhancement appearance:** Red outlines and section-shaped borders begin appearing over the sheet while the D&D Beyond loader is still visible. These outlines are **the extension’s work**, layered over the website’s character sheet.

4. **Extension activation:** Around 26.4 seconds, the central sheet area temporarily becomes largely blank while the outlined sections remain around the edges. This appears to be an **extension layout/reflow or loading transition**, though the cause is not explained on camera.

5. **Extension interface appears:** The extension’s dark, gold-accented control panel appears on the left, with **LAYOUT** and **OUTPUT** sections. Options visible include Templates, Load, Reset to Default, Manage Clones, Add Shape, Manage Compact, AI Arrange, AI Settings, Print, Print settings, and Save to Browser. This is clearly **the extension’s work**.

6. **Extension layer-management panel:** A second dark panel appears on the right titled **LAYER MANAGEMENT**. It lists **SECTIONS (22)** and **SHAPES (15)**, along with print/screen filters and individual layer names. This is **the extension’s work**.

7. **Extension status message:** A toast states, **“No saved layout yet — the default template is loaded.”** This is **the extension’s work** and is clearly distinguishable from the website.

8. **Enhanced template settles into place:** The sheet returns in a themed layout with red-bordered boxes, including ability, proficiency, walking speed, hit points, initiative, defenses, and actions areas. The central character illustration and underlying sheet content remain **the website’s**, while the enhanced boxes and layout treatment are **the extension’s work**.

9. **No spell-detail interaction is shown:** The video remains on the **ACTIONS** tab. Although a **SPELLS** tab is visible as part of the website’s tab strip, it is never selected. No spell row is opened, and no **Details** trigger is visibly activated.

## Layer 1 — Asserted-behavior evidence

| Asserted behavior | Evidence on camera |
|---|---|
| Spell rows expose a Details trigger | **NOT-VISIBLE** — no spell list or Details control is shown. |
| Clicking Details creates a floating spell detail section | **NOT-VISIBLE** — no Details click or floating spell-detail section appears. |
| Re-requesting the same spell does not duplicate the section | **NOT-VISIBLE** — no spell request or second request is demonstrated. |
| The opened spell detail eventually shows content or a retry/delete error state | **NOT-VISIBLE** — no opened spell detail, content, loading state, retry control, or delete error state appears. |

Thus, **none of the suite’s spell-detail assertions are visibly witnessed**.

## Layer 2 — Product-aim conformance

### Extension work observed working

- The extension’s **left control panel and right Layer Management panel are clearly distinguishable** from D&D Beyond through their dark “codex/workbench” styling, gold accents, and independent controls.
- The extension’s **default-layout status toast** is clearly presented and readable.
- The enhanced sheet is visibly divided into **red-bordered, movable-section-style boxes**, making the extension’s layout treatment distinguishable from the base website.
- The Layer Management panel provides visible **section and shape inventories**, including a count of 22 sections and 15 shapes.
- The transition from temporary grid/reflow to the restored themed sheet is visible.

### Affordances missing, unproven, or rough on camera

- The feature under certification—the spell **Details** affordance—is never demonstrated.
- The **SPELLS** tab is not opened, so spell rows are never shown.
- No floating spell-detail panel is created.
- No successful spell-content state is shown.
- No spell loading/pending state is shown.
- No spell **retry** or **delete** error state is shown.
- No duplicate-request protection is demonstrated.
- The extension’s controls are mostly left untouched; Load, Reset to Default, Manage Clones, Add Shape, Manage Compact, AI Arrange, Print, and Save to Browser are only displayed, not behaviorally exercised.
- No control feedback, pressed/selected state, or disabled state is demonstrated for those controls.
- No save/success toast beyond the informational “default template is loaded” message is shown.
- No error handling is shown for the extension’s panel actions.
- The brief mostly blank/reflowed sheet area around 26.4 seconds is visually rough because it provides no explanation or visible progress indicator for the transition.
- The browser toolbar is not shown clearly enough to confirm the extension’s toolbar icon or its promised **ON badge**.
- There is no visible demonstration of the extension’s OFF state after reload; the sequence shows activation and enhancement, but not a visible toolbar deactivation and return to the plain sheet.

The extension’s overall visual identity and layer-management presentation are strong and clearly separated from D&D Beyond, but this recording does not meaningfully exercise the spell-detail feature under certification.

VERDICT: NOT-VISIBLE
